import csv

with open("/home/user/input/Mall_Customers.csv", newline="") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

ages = sorted(int(r["Age"]) for r in rows if r.get("Age") not in (None, ""))
n = len(ages)
mid = n // 2
if n % 2 == 1:
    median = ages[mid]
else:
    median = (ages[mid - 1] + ages[mid]) / 2

if float(median).is_integer():
    median = int(median)

print(median)
EOF
